observations.source_excerpt: If I know earlier, I would change the plan.
observations.learner_quote: If I know earlier, I would change the plan.
observations.learning_dimension: Expressing an unreal past condition and its possible result
observations.observed_behavior: Uses present condition and conditional result for an explicitly unreal past situation
suggested_forms: If I'd known earlier, I would have changed the plan.

observations.source_excerpt: Even though the deadline was close, we delayed the release because the checks failed.
observations.learner_quote: Even though the deadline was close, we delayed the release because the checks failed.
observations.communicative_intent: Explain a decision despite a conflicting constraint
observations.learning_dimension: Expressing a concessive contrast between a constraint and a decision
observations.observed_behavior: Completes a contrast coherently after the teacher supplied only the beginning

observations.source_excerpt: My new chair was incredibly expensive, but it made long meetings more comfortable.
observations.learner_quote: My new chair was incredibly expensive, but it made long meetings more comfortable.
observations.communicative_intent: Emphasize the high cost of a purchase
observations.learning_dimension: Describing high cost with appropriate noun and adjective combinations
observations.observed_behavior: Correctly assigns expensive to the item after a conceptual contrast without a complete model

observations.source_excerpt: We were too late. Anyway, the new rollout worked.
observations.learner_quote: We were too late. Anyway, the new rollout worked.
observations.learning_dimension: Expressing an unreal past condition and its possible result
observations.observed_behavior: A targeted past-counterfactual opportunity occurred, but the learner chose an actual outcome and moved on; this is not a linguistic failure or evidence of avoidance

refs.quote: Why did you change it? Can you explain briefly?

teaching.interpretation: This asks for reasoning about one recast, without a lasting always-explain preference.
teaching.instruction: Give a brief reason for a meaningful reformulation when the learner asks.

refs.quote: Please don't give me long lists of synonyms; one useful contrast is enough for our conversations.

teaching.interpretation: The learner explicitly rejects synonym lists as an ongoing approach.
teaching.instruction: Avoid long synonym lists; prefer one useful contrast when explaining a reformulation.
